All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**1. Ticket created — DONE.** Ticket titled `fwrd33-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists, reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status **Draft**.

**2. Part A added — DONE.** Part `fwrd33-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**3. Part B added — DONE.** Part `fwrd33-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**. (Parts total at that point: $375.00.)

**4. Part A cost changed 100 → 150 — DONE.** New cost $150.00, markup 25%. App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket parts total updated to $437.50.

**5. Status set to Ready — DONE.** Precondition discovered: the first attempt was rejected with the alert *"Ticket is not ready Part 'fwrd33-n1 RD Part A' has no supplier Part 'fwrd33-n1 RD Part B' has no supplier"*. **What was required: every part on the ticket must have a supplier set.** I edited both parts and set supplier to "Generic Supplier" on each; after that, "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status displayed as **Ready** (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via Delete + "Delete part" confirmation modal, waiting for the refresh after each); parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." Archive succeeded immediately with no precondition blocking — the ticket shows status **Ready** with an **Archived** label, the action button now reads "Unarchive ticket", and the ticket no longer appears in the active ticket list (it only appears when "Show archived" is checked). Final verified state: 0 parts, archived, nothing from this run left active.
